GR32_Resamplers>TCustomKernel>ChangedMethodPublic

TCustomKernel.Changed

Notifies observers that the kernel properties or filter parameters have changed.

Declaration ​

pascal
procedure Changed;

Description ​

Changed triggers notification to registered persistent observers (such as an attached TKernelResampler), forcing precomputed weight tables or filter caches to update.
